title: OMARCHY NEWS
nodes: Omacom Foundation secures $1.95M in tokens from leading labs
Meta Superintelligence Labs joins as Founding Token Patron with $1.5 million in tokens, and Anthropic, OpenAI, and Fireworks each add $150,000 as Distinguished Token Patrons.
Everything raised this year will be spent over the next three. That means yearly budgets in excess of $4 million for 2027, 2028, and 2029.
Omarchy Patronage is now open to everyone
Patronage of the Omacom Foundation is now open to everyone in four tiers, each with its own badge, and there's more spending on the way.
Omacom Foundation hires kernel developer Krzysztof Wilczynski
The foundation's first full-time employee will lead the Omarchy Kernel work on performance, compatibility, and security.
Two hundred thousand Quattro ISOs in under 19 days, downloads from 215 countries and territories, and a date for the first million.
Omacom Foundation reaches $13M with four Distinguished Patrons
Ryan R. Hughes, Ed Huang, Adrien Treccani, and Max Schoening each pledge $100,000, and the foundation hits $13 million.
The first two Distinguished Corporate Patrons each pledge $100,000 a year for three years, taking the Omacom Foundation to $12.6 million.
Omacom Foundation welcomes Brian Armstrong and Yunjie Dai
Two more Founding Patrons join the mission with $1 million each, and the foundation hits $12 million.
Radio Atlas, Omagotchi, and AirPods take the podium in the first Omarchy plugin competition.
Omarchy tops 100,000 downloads in a week
A hundred thousand people installed Omarchy in seven days, and we moved nearly a petabyte doing it.
A six-month, funded residency for the artists who make Omarchy beautiful. The first two are HANCORE and OldJobobo.
The first Omarchy Rangers are here to help people find their way, and applications are open.
